title: This took me a long time to learn when I was growing the business... ...
description: This took me a long time to learn when I was growing the business... but once I understood, we flew 🙌
transcript: What piece of advice would you tell your 23 year old self who just started the agency in one sentence? To do way less of the jobs I was doing so when I just started and for many years, I was sales department, deliverable, lead gen, personal brand admin, the bookkeeper, I was writing the privacy policy on the website, I was website design. I look absolutely everything right. And I had to do that right at the beginning cause I didn't have money to make that not be true. But instead of being like oh, I'm making 100 K a year now, that's amazing, what I should have done is kept my lifestyle really cheap and just reinvested that like straight away instead of waiting years, having much more before starting to do to hand over all those roles. Cause all those roles, someone is better than me at it. Who I can convince to work for me and pay them. Other than me being the one in my personal practice. I said the one thing I can't get anyone else to do, but everything else, someone who's better at that should be doing it.
